architecture_decisions: Implementation of explicit server-owned execution contract for protected PLAN, ensuring deterministic end-to-end acceptance replay and real disposable candidate BUILD/TEST/VERIFY.
work_items: Implementation of source-shape validation inference replacement and deterministic end-to-end acceptance replay for protected PLAN.
validations: Validation of explicit server-owned execution contract for protected PLAN, ensuring deterministic end-to-end acceptance replay and real disposable candidate BUILD/TEST/VERIFY.

AC-01: validate protected requirement — The workstream records exact authenticated evidence that P2-V0.23.30 reached candidate admission and failed with `DISPOSABLE_CANDIDATE_VALIDATION / VALIDATION_PROFILE_ERROR`, while production infrastructure remained healthy.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — Focused tests prove protected PLAN binds one catalog execution contract to exact source-lineage/work-specification identity and persists its ID/digests/profile IDs in PLAN evidence.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — An accepted workspace with no ecosystem markers deterministically binds `static-web-v1`; once bound, candidate-created markers cannot switch that contract/profile.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — Established Parallax Python and bounded .NET source bind their existing profiles; ambiguous/unsupported/generic unadmitted shapes fail with fixed reason codes rather than falling back to static web.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — Candidate validation receives the PLAN-bound profile and performs no candidate-time or accepted-source re-inference after PLAN. Contract ID/digest/profile drift fails closed before model-authored candidate authority can affect validation.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — Focused tests prove root index requirement, local-reference integrity, JavaScript syntax checks, traversal/symlink rejection and absence of repository package-script execution or network fetching.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — Profile/contract/snapshot failures project fixed `reason_code` values without exception text, source content, generated content, filesystem roots, provider payloads or credentials.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — The exact production release runs the immutable QA fixture through `VercelCandidateValidationExecutor` in a real Vercel sandbox and records BUILD, TEST and VERIFY as protected successes. Production publication fails if this canary fails.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — Tests and implementation inspection prove the canary does not create/mutate Projects, Engineering Runs, source lineage, Git/delivery/lifecycle or REVIEW state and cannot be used as authenticated real-path acceptance.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — SafeImplementationEngine, dependency preparation, deny-all validation network, execution snapshots, independent evaluation, source lineage, Git/deployment/lifecycle authority, Luna/Terra/Sol order, 60-second hosted timeout, zero hidden retries, recovery ceilings and human REVIEW are unchanged.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — Spec/DSPy evidence, focused regressions, full API regression, applicable client checks, protected promotion evaluation, Bounded Autonomy, Workstream Spec Validation and exact-head PR gates are green.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — The exact merged application source reaches READY only after the real candidate canary passes; `/health` and `/ready` return HTTP 200 and exact-deployment runtime verification is clean.

AC-13: validate protected requirement — Only after AC-12, retry Engineering Run `3a1ba66a-5649-42b6-81ee-91684fe06bbc` or equivalent exact work through the signed-in product path. It must enter disposable candidate BUILD/TEST/VERIFY under the PLAN-bound contract or expose a genuinely later bounded blocker.
risks: Risk of candidate validation re-infering profile from source after PLAN, mitigated by explicit server-owned execution contract.
